module: Management of photo mode presets, of three types: camera, scene and effects. Each type is stored in a JSON file under settings/photomode/presets/ (camera.json, scene.json, effects.json); the state is captured or applied by the modules ui_photomode_camera, _scene and _effects. The module also manages a temporary "Defaults" preset (state captured at the start of the session) and the temporary presets provided by these modules.
notes: File format: {version=1, presets={...}}; each preset has id (UUID), type, version=1, name, createdAt, updatedAt, origin, data. New presets are inserted at the head of the list.
The default preset has the identifier "__defaults" and temporary=true; deleting it does not erase it from disk, it is only hidden until resetTemporaryPresets.
Scene-type camera presets (data.cameraPresetType == "scene") are listed/applicable only in the level whose identifier matches data.levelId.

The functions return {ok=false, reason=...} on failure (preset_type_invalid, preset_not_found, preset_capture_failed, preset_write_failed, preset_bundle_invalid). On success, the table does not necessarily contain the ok field.
renamePreset and deletePreset only affect presets in the file (renaming a temporary preset returns preset_not_found).

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: ui_photomode_camera, ui_photomode_scene, ui_photomode_effects.

resetTemporaryPresets.desc: Resets the temporary state: discovered presets, hidden presets and the session's captured default states.

captureSessionDefaultPresets.desc: Captures, for each preset type, the current default state (captureDefaultPresetState of the relevant module). Serves as the content of the "Defaults" preset. To be called at the start of a photo session.

listPresets.desc: Lists the presets of a type: the default preset (if not hidden), the temporary presets already discovered, then those from the file available in the current level.

discoverTemporaryPresets.desc: Enables the inclusion of the module's temporary presets (getTemporaryPresetList) for this type, then returns the full list.

saveCurrentPreset.desc: Captures the current state of the module of the given type (capturePresetState) and saves it as a new preset at the head of the file.

options.desc: Options passed to capturePresetState ({} by default).

applyPreset.desc: Applies a preset by identifier (default, temporary or from the file) via the relevant module's applyPresetState.

options.desc: Options passed to applyPresetState ({} by default).

deletePreset.desc: Deletes a preset from the file; for the default preset or a temporary preset, only hides it.

renamePreset.desc: Renames a preset saved in the file and updates updatedAt.

applyPresetPayload.desc: Directly applies a preset payload (for example imported from a capture's metadata), without going through storage.

payload.desc: Preset table; if it contains a data field, that is what is applied, otherwise the whole table.

savePresetPayload.desc: Saves a given payload (without capturing the current state) as a new preset at the head of the file.

payload.desc: Preset data (data field or whole table).

origin.desc: Provenance stored in the preset's origin field (inferred from code).

savePresetBundle.desc: Saves a preset bundle: for each of camera, scene, effects present in the bundle, calls savePresetPayload with the name "<prefix> <type>". Stops at the first failure.

getScreenshotPresetBundle.desc: Captures the current state of the three modules as a bundle intended for a screenshot's metadata.
